what: THE FIRST MINUTE. UI round 3 (11/2/26) made the machine, the start screen's picks and the hints toggle; UI 5 (11/3/26, asks 338 and 340, his 11/2 NO on the machine) made THE FEED: the loading screen is a camera's own feed, three made through the master rig, the pick in the game, all three on the VOTE tab; the picks restyled as the camera's own buttons. Every number the first minute reads is here. Words are draft:true attempts for WORDS.

lines.map: Tap anywhere on the map and we walk there. The clock runs while we walk.
lines.town: Tap a building to go in. LEAVE on the phone takes us back out.
lines.camp: We heal quicker at camp. The ring on the phone breaks camp.

feed._why: rules 342 (his second star, 11/2: 'Why not all 3?... as much of these as possible to really build that lore ambience') and 348 (11/3: two versions, tall 9:16 and wide 16:9, full screen, first person, quiet; a random feed each open, never twice running; the monitor cuts to the next camera after about 40 s). a.name: THE CAMP ON TAPE
a.what: the crew's camp: the fire in a barrel, the truck, the tyres; a camcorder held by one of the crew

b.name: THE NIGHT CAMERA
b.what: a security camera over the pawn shop's lot: the sodium lamp dying twice a bar, a coyote in the light

c.name: THE ROAD IN
c.what: the dash camera on the dead I-15 into the Strip: every tower dark but one lit block, the needle and the black pyramid on the sky, the freeway's lights dead

d.name: THE INTAKE
d.what: the dam's camera over Lake Mead: the intake towers in low water, the white bathtub ring on the walls, one red light still blinking

e.name: THE PENS
e.what: a trail camera's infrared in the lab yard: cage three burst from inside, the cold-store truck's panel still lit, a dire wolf standing in the yard

f.name: THE APRON
f.what: the tower's camera over the dead apron: the plane on its belly, the jet bridge to nothing, the one mast light failing, a mountain lion

g.name: THE FLARE
g.what: a camcorder left on its tripod at the landfill: the methane flare still burning over the trash mounds and the fence, the dead dozer; the dogs only heard

h.name: THE MARKET
h.what: a town's market after closing: the stalls under their tarps, one bulb on the wire still lit, a dog asleep by a table

i.name: THE PYLON
i.what: a camcorder dropped in the sand, still recording, tilted: a power pylon down across the desert, Joshua trees, a buried car with its headlights on

j.name: THE FOUNTAIN
j.what: a casino's porte-cochere camera: the dry fountain, the fallen sign with one bulb of its hundred lit, the limo, the bridge
